procedure.method: Fresh independent session; no spawn, fork, resume or peer/producer records. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, compact addendum, README, adapter and ratio/source/poster manifests without following their unlisted paths. Verified bytes/hashes and PNG dimensions; those checks were not treated as image opens. Actually opened the exact source original.png through tools.view_image(detail=original) and received/viewed its pixels. The packet has no protected layouts. Then actually opened and viewed M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320 through tools.view_image(detail=original), with each image emitted by functions.exec. All fifteen exact poster views were completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. First raw readings below were taken from the displayed native pixels after complete viewing, separately from supplied required copy; no OCR, omitted-copy inference, crop, image edit, regeneration or revisit was used. No runtime session ID is observable here. Native 1672x941 or 1672x940 uses the predeclared half-pixel single-edge rounding allowance; usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180. This critic judges visible source identity, not invisible maker intent or undocumented actual call attachments.
